{{Quote|The planet's name is Dathomir. It seems the planet holds many Force users of great power. However, the Emperor found it first - he's blockaded the planet and placed a nightcloak generator system in orbit.|[[Urai Fen]]|<ref name="FoC" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] established a '''blockade''' of the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to prevent the powerful [[Witches of Dathomir]] to escape their planet.

==History==
{{Quote|I believe the Emperor himself was afraid of the Nightsisters. That's why he interdicted this planet. Years ago, he started a nice little penal colony here, not knowing about the Nightsisters. When he learned about them, he blew the planet's airfield from orbit and stranded hundreds of his own people here, along with the prisoners, rather than risk letting Gethzerion escape. That's how frightened he was of Gethzerion.''"<br />"''Those warships up above us were put there to keep people on this rock as much as to keep them fenced out. And now that Zsinj is in charge of this sector, he's still afraid. The Imperials who got stranded at the prison might still be able to cobble some kind of a ship together, and Zsinj has to watch out for that.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Augwynne Djo]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TCoPL" />}}
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a [[Invasion of Dathomir|presence]] on the remote planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. While [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was aware of the presence of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Witches of Dathomir]], he allowed the construction of a [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|prison]] on the planet.<ref name="GatORW" /> However, it was not long before the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], a sect of evil Dathomiri Witches, corrupted the Imperial troops using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and turned them against their officers.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|65|Who's Who in Star Wars Galaxies|Who's Who in ''Star Wars'' Galaxies}}</ref>

[[File:DathomirStation.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Dathomir Station]] controlled access to the planet.]]
As the Emperor realized that the Nightsisters and their leader [[Gethzerion]] were more powerful than what he expected, he ordered the Witches to be confined on their planet.<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the Emperor tasked [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zsinj]] to prevent the Nightsisters to escape Dathomir using the Imperial starships parked at the prison. Zsinj therefore [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the Imperial prison from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], destroying every vessels<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and communication equipment present on the planet.<ref name="Insider" /> All Imperial forces at the surface were abandoned, they eventually became the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for the Nightsisters.<ref name="GatORW" /> Zsinj established a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the planet Dathomir<ref name="Despoilers" /> and the Emperor ordered that at least two [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] guarded the planet at all times.<ref name="CTD" /> Imperial ships were assigned to perform orbital scans periodically to ensure that the Nightsisters were still confined, with strict orders to never land on the planet.<ref name="TDSS" /> In addition, [[orbital nightcloak]]s were deployed in orbit.<ref name="FoC" /> In the next years, the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] remained under the control of Zsinj<ref name="TNEGtC" /> as the latter was promoted [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Quelii Oversector]].<ref name="Despoilers" />

[[File:Zsinj-CTD.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Zsinj blockaded Dathomir for almost a decade.]]
Despite the Imperial blockade, the Dathomir system attracted a great deal of attention at the height of the Galactic Civil War, being the site of numerous skirmishes between Imperial and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=expansions_sectors_dath.jsp|text=Dathomir System}}</ref> During this period, [[Tyber Zann]], the leader of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], dispatched a [[defiler]] to disable an orbital [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] in order to be able to access Dathomir. Along with his lieutenant [[Urai Fen]], he [[Ground Battle on Dathomir|landed]] on the planet where he recruited [[Silri]] and a group of Nightsisters to his service.<ref name="FoC" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the blockade had been quite loosened, being focused in one [[Empire Blockade|quadrant]] of Dathomir space. Intrepid [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] frequently managed to lure the Imperial [[Dathomir Station]] and get through the blockade to land at one of the [[Trade Outpost|two]] [[Science Outpost|outposts]] present on Dathomir.<ref name="SWG" />

After the death of the Emperor at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Zsinj became a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and created its own [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]] from the Quelii Oversector. As Zsinj waged a [[Hunt for Zsinj|war]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the warlord was not eager to waste [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in guarding Dathomir anymore. However, when rich deposits of minerals were discovered on Dathomir's moon of [[Koratas]], Zsinj ordered the construction of massive [[Shipyard/Legends|shipbuilding facilities]] in orbit of Dathomir: [[Rancor Base]]. Since a number of Star Destroyers were assigned to the defense of the shipyard, they were tasked to maintain the blockade of the planet as well.<ref name="CTD" />

A large [[Hapan Royal Navy|Hapan fleet]] attacked Dathomir in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], destroying [[Rancor Base]], most of Zsinj's fleet and the [[orbital nightcloak]]s. Warlord Zsinj was killed during the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|battle]] when his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], was destroyed.<ref name="TCoPL" /> The blockade was broken as all remaining Imperial forces quickly fled the system and the united Witch clans requested membership into the New Republic.<ref name="CTD" />
